runs.text: Application Engineer with over 4 years of experience in Industrial Automation and BMS - HVAC domain.
Profcient in programming and designing domain specifc systems tailored to meet customer requirements.
Self-driven, result oriented and an extensive team player focused in on-time quality deliverables.
SW Tools: Siemens TIA Portal, Simatic WinCC SCADA / HMI, EBO, Andover Continuum, PCT, AET, MS Visio
DP/PA, HART, MODBUS, RSTP, BACnet, Ethernet/IP, MSTP, OPC DA/UA
3-Phase PLC code development integrated with HMI / SCADA designs.
Remotely supported the onsite team in FAT / SAT during commisioning at client sites.
Programming of modern controllers (ES, AS-P, AS-B, MP/RP) to deliver control and monitoring solutions to building verticals for efcient automation and energy management.
Assisted in preparing technical estimations for BMS projects.

Recognized for developing a standardized template using the PI-PDCA methodology, resulting in soft cost and efort savings by streamlining the process of requesting IP address and site data from clients.
